source_access.coverage_limit: The public projection contains prior interpretations and media-review descriptions, not original posts/media. Metadata saying full_text_retained_locally does not prove present completeness.
source_access.other_source_scope: The original November 5 caption schema and first concept were inspected; all ten structure identities and fields were inspected. Caption/media final review belongs to the integrator and visual reviewer.

lessons.name: Define popularity relative to its evidence and cohort
lessons.observation: Eight saved strong-relative labels come from four author/format/age/language cohorts. Their observed reactions range from 53 to 5,518; an ordinary-reference post has 1,904. Absolute counter size and relative standing answer different questions.
lessons.application: Use the reader job and evidence packet to choose a structure. Describe any counter as a dated observation, never as viral reach, buyer quality or proof of the technique.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: Creator audience, publication age, topic, distribution and promotion can explain differences;245 of 279 posts lack enough comparable source records.

lessons.name: Show a professional decision rather than manufacture vulnerability
lessons.observation: The two high relative image-story references use personal before/after situations, while another same-cohort story is ordinary relative to its author. The functional transfer is an intelligible choice and reflection, not a guaranteed story effect.
lessons.application: Recover the actual goal, constraint, rejected alternative, choice, consequence and interpretation. Without a confirmed event, write a proposed method or labelled example.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: A strong author network and an older post can generate large counters independently of story structure. First-person account and commercial results remain source-reported.

lessons.name: Make one useful routine or mechanism inspectable
lessons.observation: Source interpretations contrast concrete meeting agreements, clarifying questions and role responsibilities with a small abstract forecast. The observed counts do not isolate which component mattered.
lessons.application: Show a sequence with a real input, decision, output and owner; explain why each transition matters. Keep metaphors secondary to the literal workflow.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: The low-relative listening routine is still practically useful. A named proprietary concept and a strong-relative label do not verify its persuasion claims.

lessons.name: Choose a visual that explains the same relationship as the argument
lessons.observation: Saved prior assessments describe diagnostic tables, a four-question graphic and a layered positioning equation. Their exact fine print was not fully audited; this review did not reopen source images.
lessons.application: Use a checklist for missing information, a path for a workflow, a table for alternatives, or a sourced chart for a measured comparison. Repeat the literal claim and limitation in accessible text.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: The report labels only 13 framework/diagram posts from four authors. It is not an independent test of diagrams, and the source examples include text-led methods too.

lessons.name: Connect evidence to a bounded consequence
lessons.observation: A strong-relative reframe example includes unsupported prescriptions; a low-relative everyday analogy remains a recognizable explanatory device. Neither supplies causal business evidence.
lessons.application: State what the observation supports, explain the reasoning and name the condition that would change the conclusion. A hypothetical workflow can explain a method but cannot establish product performance.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: Concrete detail, a citation or a precise statistic can still be irrelevant, selected or unverified. Do not add old survey percentages or implied savings merely to make a panel persuasive.

lessons.name: Use humor for recognition when it fits the author and stakes
lessons.observation: A saved dialogue-humor interpretation uses a recognizable communication difficulty. The adjacent-humor topic contains only six selected posts; an entertain job is a different label and also has six.
lessons.application: A small reversal or plainly illustrative scene may add interest. Keep data, product limitations, privacy and fictional-person labels literal. Humor is optional and needs author voice review.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: These categories do not establish a humor uplift or show that forced jokes improve trust. Fictional dialogue cannot become a claimed founder or customer event.

lessons.name: Do not turn format or account medians into a universal rule
lessons.observation: Aggregate image reactions have a higher median than text in the selected report, but within-author image/text comparisons split six positive and five negative. These comparisons have only two or more observations per format and do not hold age/topic/promotion constant.
lessons.application: Select the medium for the explanation. Give a founder account a confirmed decision and a company account a distinct process or proof artifact instead of duplicating both or promising better reach.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: April Dunford image versus text medians 560 versus 738 reverse the aggregate; Chris Orlob image 32.5 versus text 41.5 does as well. No account type, carousel length, font or image style is causally preferred by this corpus.

lessons.name: Let the ending serve the job rather than a template
lessons.observation: The saved corpus has 63 offer announcements, 91 method posts and six discussion posts; observed reaction medians do not reveal conversion. One strong-relative source explicitly refuses a blanket engagement-based length recommendation.
lessons.application: Close a diagnosis with a usable check, a research observation with its conclusion, a real uncertainty with one answerable question, and an offer with its approved next step.
lessons.counterexample_or_alternative: A self-selected reply is not a representative buyer survey. A low reaction median does not justify banning offers or replacing Book an intro call with a comment request.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Show why one product choice matters to a buyer. Keep an illustrative editorial observation until the author confirms a real decision.
publication_implications.visual_function: Use one product→choice→buyer relationship; no fictional portrait may imply a testimonial.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Actual founder decision, approved stance and permission if adding an episode.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Lead with the bounded question and the 279-post denominator; place 276 reaction / 256 comment observations beside their medians and state 22 October 2026.
publication_implications.visual_function: A small source-labelled count/coverage table, not a viral leaderboard.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Keep cohort selection and missing reach/conversion explicit.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Ask why the rejected alternative was plausible, what the author knew then and what changed. Keep process language proposed.
publication_implications.visual_function: A question→source note→draft→author check path, with any dialogue explicitly illustrative.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Permissioned interview before a first-person story or client claim.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Make all four promised checks visible: buyer, task, alternative and supported difference. Label the rewrite hypothetical.
publication_implications.visual_function: Four-check diagnostic with readable labels and a single concrete before/after sentence.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Product/buyer confirmation before substituting a real example.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Separate an asserted capability, a one-off demonstration and a repeated measurement; explain what each can support.
publication_implications.visual_function: A literal evidence ladder or claim→test→limit table. Do not retain the omitted 73% figure in old artwork.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Real demo, baseline, sample, period and owner confirmation before performance wording.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Follow trigger→input→output→human review → next decision. Retain technical detail that changes evaluation.
publication_implications.visual_function: One consistent workflow diagram whose arrows mean sequence, not measured improvement.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Technical-owner approval and cleared source screenshots for an actual implementation.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Allocate different contributions to one buyer question. Do not claim founder accounts causally outperform company accounts.
publication_implications.visual_function: Two role columns sharing one question; avoid mirrored copy and invented identity proof.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Actual account roles, source ownership and author agreement.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Ask what relationship the image helps the reader assess; distinguish explanation, demonstration and illustration.
publication_implications.visual_function: Choose the representation by job. Keep fictional-scene disclosures and source/limit labels readable at mobile scale.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Actual source asset if a visual is meant as product or customer evidence.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: Make this a decision-to-measure diagnostic instead of repeating post02. Unknown buyer intent and missing impressions stay unknown.
publication_implications.visual_function: Question→availablemeasure→unanswereddecision map, with null clearly distinguished from observed zero.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Actual comment text or outcome analytics before asserting comprehension, intent or sales.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.

publication_implications.writing_implication: State fit, founder input, proposed output, review responsibility and the exact approved CTA. Make no reach or sales guarantee.
publication_implications.visual_function: A concise service/output handoff; avoid depicting illustrative scenes as customers or finished results.
publication_implications.remaining_source_hold: Operational capability, voice and exact offer scope review; retain Book an intro call.
publication_implications.architecture_scope: Source-backed proposed structure; not author-approved final copy or rebuilt artwork.
